belief: I'm not a real man or woman if I don't measure up.
origins: Culture, family, and church set lists of what “real” men and women do: earn, protect, cook, parent, look a certain way. Singleness, infertility, job loss, illness, or differing gifts can feel like failing at manhood or womanhood.
teaches: “God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.” Our identity as God’s image-bearers is given, not earned. “Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.” Deborah judged Israel, and Hannah wept in infertility, yet both were honored. Paul says, “There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.” Our standing is in Christ, not in a checklist.
self_statements: I am failing at being who I should be.
I do not fit the mold.
Others measure up and I do not.
My circumstances prove I am less.
errors: Believing I either fit the standard or am inadequate.
Assuming others see me as less.
Feeling inadequate and concluding that I am.
Predicting that I will never measure up.
questions: Who set the list I am measuring myself against?
Which items come from Scripture, and which from culture?
What does Scripture say about my identity?
Who do I admire who does not fit the mold?
How would I counsel a friend with the same circumstances?
What are my gifts and calling right now?
truth: I am made in God’s image and secure in Christ. Manhood and womanhood are not a checklist I must pass. I can grow in character and use my gifts, knowing my worth is not up for a vote.
hw_truths: I am made in God’s image.
My identity is given, not earned.
I can think of myself with sober judgment.
I have gifts and a calling.
log: Each week, note one way you used your gifts without comparing.
actions: Note the standards you measure yourself against.
Mark which are from Scripture and which are culture.
Write five things you do well.
Say it when you feel less.
prayer: Lord, I have measured myself by lists. Remind me that I am Your image-bearer, secure in Christ, with gifts to use. Amen.
hw_questions: What would I tell a friend?
name_example: Sarah can write: “I am made in God’s image, and my identity is secure in Christ.”
